diagnosis.rationale: New capability; current checks are characterized and green, with no unresolved defect diagnosis.

dsa.rationale: Bounded registries, metadata documents, and sequential result records require no consequential representation decision.

tdd.rationale: Observable behaviors, test levels, characterization, and Red ordering assessed and incorporated into plan r2. Complete Compose discovery was rechecked against spec r2/plan r3.

security.rationale: Secrets, runtime privilege, CI permissions, artifact redaction, and supply-chain pins assessed and incorporated.

migration.rationale: Versioned additive metadata rollout, manual review, expiring exceptions, and rollback assessed and incorporated. Complete Compose discovery was rechecked against spec r2/plan r3.

performance.rationale: Time/byte bounds, caching, safe concurrency, and reliability sampling assessed and incorporated.

accessibility-ux.rationale: No visual UI; deterministic CLI readability and actionable diagnostics are acceptance requirements.

operations.rationale: Rootless capabilities, unique ownership, readiness, cleanup, leak detection, CI activation, and rollback assessed and incorporated. Complete Compose discovery was rechecked against spec r2/plan r3.

compatibility.rationale: Additive interface, direct commands, Podman provider behavior, service semantics, and admin boundary assessed and incorporated. Complete Compose discovery was rechecked against spec r2/plan r3.
